courses.title: Apache Kafka Essential Training: Getting Started
courses.why: The quickest Kafka certificate on LinkedIn Learning (Kumaran Ponnambalam): topics, partitions, consumer groups, the command line and a small use-case project. It predates Kafka 4.0, so read the kafka-core chapter for KRaft and the new consumer protocol.

courses.title: Kafka: Building Reliable Real-Time Event Systems
courses.why: The most current Kafka course on LinkedIn Learning (KodeKloud): producers and consumers in depth, Confluent's offerings, Kafka Connect and building an event-driven system. Worth the extra time if you want one Kafka certificate that reflects 2026 Kafka.

courses.title: Apache Kafka 101
courses.why: Free and written by the company founded by Kafka's creators. It is also the best preparation for Confluent's free Data Streaming Engineer Foundations exam below. Follow it with the 39-minute 'Apache Kafka for Python Developers' course on the same site.

portals.name: Apache Kafka quickstart (official)
portals.what: Run a single-node KRaft broker, create a topic, produce and consume: the hands-on baseline before any interview.

portals.name: Confluent Developer: free Kafka courses
portals.what: Short official courses on Kafka Streams, Schema Registry, Kafka Connect, internal architecture, security and Python clients.

portals.name: Conduktor Kafkademy
portals.what: Free, well-illustrated lessons on Kafka concepts and the CLI, from topics and partitions to producer and consumer settings.

portals.name: GeeksforGeeks: Kafka interview questions
portals.what: 90+ Kafka interview questions including KRaft, ISR, acks, min.insync.replicas and idempotent producers (prefer this newer page; the older 'Top 70' page still describes ZooKeeper).

assessments.name: Data Streaming Engineer Foundations
assessments.format: Online exam, 30 multiple-choice and true/false questions, 60 minutes, not proctored, take it any time
assessments.credential: Confluent digital badge sent by email after you pass
assessments.why: The fastest credible Kafka credential: free, unproctored, and from Confluent. Take it right after Apache Kafka 101.

assessments.name: Confluent Fundamentals Accreditation for Apache Kafka
assessments.format: Free self-paced training with an accreditation exam
assessments.why: Confluent's official first step towards its paid certifications; a second free badge that shows structured Kafka study.

assessments.name: Confluent Certified Developer for Apache Kafka (CCDAK)
assessments.cost: About $150 per attempt (Confluent's page shows the price at checkout; third-party guides list $150)
assessments.format: 90-minute proctored online exam; multiple-choice, matching and ordering questions
assessments.credential: Confluent certification and digital badge, valid for 2 years
assessments.why: The recognised Kafka developer certification. Worth it once you have built the Kafka project and passed the free exams; it is the credential recruiters search for.
